g.text: Document management and archive — Processes and Capabilities

One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A long list against a low criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Qualify, price, and contract servicing client
Investigate and file suspicious activity report
Execute credit line decrease or account action
Set deposit rates and product terms
Process CD maturity, renewal, and early withdrawal
Administer deposit insurance records and escheatment
Review contract package and clear stipulations
Assign repossession and send required notices
Onboard and oversee ISO or agent
Refer account to legal and manage litigation
